blurb: A line of three or more dashes opens a documentation block, and a line of exactly the same number of dashes closes it. Here no closing line follows, so the compiler cannot tell where the documentation ends. There is no standalone `---` divider; a divider is a comment, `// ---`. Add the closing line.
example:
---                                // ✗ never closed
Doubles a number.
fn double(n: Int) -> Int { n * 2 }

---
Doubles a number.
---                                // ✓ closed with as many dashes
fn double(n: Int) -> Int { n * 2 }
summary: A documentation block is not closed.
